description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing device authentication tokens, including storing, loading, and clearing tokens with associated metadata in an Android environment.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a device authentication token entry with token, role, scopes, and last update time.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Internal data class used for storing metadata about device authentication, including scopes and update timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that interacts with SecurePrefs to persist tokens and metadata.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a device authentication entry from preferences based on device ID and role.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads only the token string for a device ID and role.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a token for a device ID and role, updating associated metadata.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the token and metadata entries for a device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Generates a preference key for storing the token, normalizing device ID and role.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Generates a preference key for storing metadata, normalizing device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Normalizes device ID by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes role string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Normalizes list of scope strings by trimming, filtering out empty strings, removing duplicates, and sorting.
